summary: An internal-node RopeSlice ending between CR and LF undercounts len_lines() by one because its end metadata uses the unsliced tree's line-break count. With CR line recognition enabled, the fix detects the split and counts the slice's trailing CR as a line break. The fix-added test checks prefix line counts using the existing small unit-test tree capacity. Reversing only end_info restores the original calculation without changing tests. No tests were executed.
